articleTitle: Discharge properties and diagnosis of gas pressure in vacuum interrupter
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Vacuum circuit breaker (VCB) is widely used in medium voltage distribution system to control and protect power lines and equipments. The internal pressure of vacuum interrupter (VI) is one of the most important parameters for VCBs' performance. If the slow leak cannot be detected and timely solved, VI will cause serious faults. Therefore, a high sensitivity and reliable detecting device is essential. In this paper, the signal intensity of the discharge signal caused by the discharge occurring inside the VI whose degree of vacuum could be varied was measured. The partial discharge inception voltages plotted against the internal pressure of the VI showed a convex downward curve. Increasing the internal pressure to atmospheric from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> pa for simulating the process of leak, we had stored the discharge waveforms by using digital oscilloscope under various pressures. Furthermore, by altering the probe's material, designing the signal conditioning circuit and optimizing criterion algorithm, the anti-interference ability of the equipment had been improved. A large series of experiments had been executed in this paper and certified that the device could be applied not only as a alarm system but could also be used to develop a diagnosis system that could estimate the vacuum degree of a VCB by analysis of the discharge pattern.

articleTitle: Novel shunt hybrid active power filter using predictive method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A novel hybrid active power filter, composed of passive power filters and active power filter, is proposed for harmonic suppression and high capacity reactive power compensation. A kind of configuration of the hybrid power filter has been presented and its basic principle is addressed, furthermore, the design of passive power filters and the analysis of harmonic current injected by active power filter are given in detail. Predictive method is adopted to detect the harmonics and it is implemented on a DSP-based controller. Simulation and industrial application results have shown the effectiveness of the proposed injection type hybrid active power filter and control methods, it can meet the demand of major industry to suppress harmonic and compensate reactive power to save the energy.

articleTitle: 10kV straight line fault location based on “Signal injection method”
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In distribution power systems, single-phase earth-faults usually happen. With the development of network automation and the rise of power supply quality of users, how to remove the faults quickly and restore normal power supply becomes people's concern. The proposed method of “Signal injection method” and the device of small current grounding location solve the problem of fault line selection, but fault location problem still exists. Based on the fault line selection, this paper analyzes the voltage and current of the detected signals and deduces the fault distance formula. Matlab/Simulink simulations verify the accuracy of this method. This method isn't affected by load and arc extinction coil, influenced little by the ground resistance, and has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Modified adaptive PSO algorithm to solve dynamic economic dispatch
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In this paper, a Modified Adaptive PSO (MAPSO) algorithm is presented to solve Dynamic Economic Dispatch (DED) problem with valve-point effects and ramp-rate limits consideration taken into account. Moreover, the transmission losses are satisfied. A mutation operator is invented to prevent premature phenomena and lead the swarm search space much more effectively. The efficiency of the proposed method is validated applying it to two test systems, consisting 5 thermal units with losses and 10 thermal units by neglecting the losses. The results are compared with the results reported in the literature. It is shown that the optimum results can be obtained more economically and quickly using the proposed method in comparison with the earlier methods.

articleTitle: Study of ultra-high-speed power switching-off of SSCB for coal mine low-voltage system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper analyses the reality of traditional three phase AC contactless switch, and points out the inherence break time is over 10ms. It puts forward using IGBT as the main component of solid state circuit breaker for the transformer neutral point's contactless switch. This enables that the operating time of ultra-high-speed short circuit protection is less than 1ms. In addition, this paper has proposed a transient mathematical model for a turning-off process of transformer neutral point SSCB. The total switching-off time has been obtained by theoretical analysis and validated by tests.

articleTitle: A new method of 5 000 h artificial accelerating ageing test for composite insulator
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: With the increase of service time, more and more attention has been paid on the long-term performances of silicone rubber (SR) composit insulator. After analyzing the characteristics of ageing process of domestic composite insulators in service, we put forward an improved method of 5 000 h multi-factor accelerated artificial ageing test based on IEC 5 000 h Multi-factor aging test method. This method is planned to more reasonably simulate the pollution process of composite insulators in the industrial inland pollution environment that contains heavy ESDD & NSDD contaminants, which can represent most domestic pollution environment, The melioration of the new method comprised prolonging the time of ageing factors. This method not only can satisfactorily rank performances of composit insulators and screen composit insulators, but also can successfully simulate environmental characteristics in service.

articleTitle: Power quality harmonic detection based on Fast-ICA
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The main methods of power quality's harmonics detection are based on instantaneous reactive power theory, FFT and wavelet transform. A method of detecting power quality's harmonics based on ICA is proposed. First, independent component analysis method is introduced briefly, then using the Fast - ICA algorithm and negative entropy great independence standards to implement the estimations of harmonics signal, obtain base wave signal and every harmonic signal. The simulation results show that this method can accurately detect every harmonic composition of the multiple harmonics and it is not sensitive to noise. So it is suitable to the detection of power quality's harmonics.

articleTitle: Fault location for distribution networks based on pattern recognition technique
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Proposed a method to identify a faulted section in d distribution network by voltage sags pattern recognition. The method establish analytical voltage sags database using fault analysis. When a real short circuit fault occurs, the voltage at the monitored node is compared with the analytical voltage sags in the database to find all the possible fault sections. Then, the method applied rank reasoning analysis to prioritize all the possible fault sections, and check the possible fault section according to the rank. Through simulating for an 11kV typical test distribution network, it proves the proposed method's validity and accuracy.

articleTitle: A supply chain optimization DSS Web-services-based for e-retail industry
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper explores the integrated development and application of incorporating recommendation system with decision support system and proposes a supply chain optimization DSS Web-services-based for e-retail industry. This system includes three basic models and many databases, such as recommended commodity database, storehouse information database, supplier information database and other external messages. It based on web services that can make calling model or database as convenient as invoking function. This system offers decision makers of e-retail companies a comprehensive view about information relating to supply chain optimization. Hence, decision maker can grasp various influencing factors and finally make significant decisions that are helpful for development of e-retail companies.

articleTitle: Research on an novel active anti-islanding method based on positive feedback of even harmonic current disturbance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Islanding protection is necessary for the distributed generation (DG) systems. To overcome the limitations of the passive anti-islanding methods, this paper analyzes the islanding detection abilities about different disturbance signals and finds the disturbance signal which suits to multi-inverter DG systems. Combining with zero-crossing frequency detector (ZFD), the positive feedback perturbation method about harmonic current injection is also introduced in the paper. The output current reference is affected by a minute disturbance signal, and the voltage frequency at the point of common coupling (PCC) moves beyong a preset threshold value when the utility grid is disconnected. The current distortion caused by this method is less compared to other active methods. The performance of the proposed method has been studied by some simulations using MATLAB/Simulink and experiments. Selected results are presented to confirm its validity.

articleTitle: A precise measurement method for positive sequence parameters of EHV and UHV transmission lines and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A precise measurement method for positive sequence parameters of EHV and UHV AC transmission lines is proposed. The mathematical models are presented in detail. Global Positioning System (GPS) is used as the synchronous signal for the measurement carried out at different substations simultaneously. The measurement device and digital simulation results are given. Finally, the measurement results of two 500 kV AC transmission lines are given and compared with the measured results by traditional method. Results from both simulation and on-site measurement show that the proposed measurement method is feasible, and its measurement accuracy can satisfactorily meet the requirements of engineering measurement.

articleTitle: A 10kW DC-DC system based on a bidirectional high-frequency isolated dual active bridge DC-DC topology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper mainly studies that the steady state of a bidirectional high-frequency isolated dual active bridge DC-DC converter and according to its small-signal model, a feedback system based on a 10KW DC-DC converter will be designed. The proposed converter topology with numerous advantages and the utilization of a high-frequency isolated transformer is suitable for high-power-density and high-power applications. In order to make it easy for obtaining desired output voltage with high accuracy and a large compensator will be designed and a simulation will validate the analysis.

articleTitle: A novel on-line training solution using a Radial Basis Function Network to modify the inverse kinematic approximation of a robot-vision system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper describes a new practical approach for approximating the inverse kinematics of a manipulator using an RBFN (Radial Basis Function Network). This neural network with its inherent learning ability can be an effective alternative solution for the inverse kinematics problem where traditional methods are impractical because the manipulator geometry cannot be easily determined, e.g. in a robot-vision system. However, sometimes a well-trained network cannot work effectively in the operational phase because the initial network training occurs in an environment that is not exactly the same as the environment where the system is actually deployed. In this paper, an on-line retraining solution using the Delta rule is presented for systems whose characteristics change due to environmental variations. Moreover, a “free interference rule” is also suggested to avoid learning interference where the training effect of a current training point may upset some of the weights which were trained with previous points. To verify the performance of the proposed approach, a practical experiment has been performed using a Mitsubishi PA10-6CE manipulator observed by a webcam. All application programmes, such as robot servo control, neural network, and image processing tool, were written in C/C++ and run in a real robotic system. The experimental results prove that the proposed approach is effective.

publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper introduces a kind of single-phase switched reluctance motor based on 4/4 pole structure. The motor structure, working principle and its drive circuit are described. And some of its special features and advantages are discussed. Then the reliable performance of this motor system is verified by experiments. So this kind of single-phase switched reluctance motor drive system is considered to have some application value and meaning of research.

articleTitle: An experimental study of pulsatile airflow in the fan inlet of an air-cooling heat exchanger using power spectrum analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Natural wind has great effects on the performance of direct air-cooling condensers. In order to study the interaction between natural wind and wind from air-cooling fans, pulsatile velocity of airflow in the fan inlet of an air-cooling heat exchanger was measured with IFA300 hot-film anemometry and analyzed using power spectrum analysis. The results show that the power spectrum exponent is small closed to the fan and increased gradually with the increase of the distance from the fan. Correspondingly, the air velocity is large near the fan and decay to the environment condition with the increase of the distance from the fan.

articleTitle: Study on hydropower pricing model based on pareto improvement criterion
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Based on the Pareto improvement criterion, this paper proposes a model of hydropower pricing using Shapley value approach. The penalty factor and reward factor of hydropower price are introduced in the model to achieve a discriminating hydropower pricing by providing effective economic signals. In this model the object to minimize the ratio of the economic reduction of hydropower and the reduction of line loss is also involved. Further, a case study is presented to analyze and illustrate the implications and characteristics of the proposed model. It is showed that the new hydropower pricing model can achieve a win-win result for operational efficiency of the power grid and economic efficiency of the small hydropower plants.

articleTitle: Applied research of multilevel generalized morphological filter for ultrasonic signal of PD in processing
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The multilevel generalized morphological filter (GMF) with the fixed weights, considering root-mean-square error and signal to noise ratio, is presented based on the close and open transforms and their combination modes. The methodology overcomes the steepest descent method on the adaptive generalized morphological filter when iterative weight is close to the best one because of slow constrictions. The algorithm is applied in the partial discharge (PD) processing in order to improve the precision of obtaining the real ultrasonic signal of PD in the stress of complicated electromagnetic environment. It ensures the accuracy of the further analysis and diagnosis. The results show that the best variable weight generalized morphological filter can multi-class noise such as positive and negative impulse noise effectively. And it is calculated and came true simply by hardware (embedded system).

articleTitle: Study on a practical target for Energy-Conservation Based Dispatch
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper analyzes the problems with Energy-Conservation Based Dispatch (ECD), discusses the necessity to establish a practical operation target from two aspects, the target and constraints for ECD. Considering coal consumption, water consumption, emissions, network loss, and transport consumption, the authors revises the energy consumption of air-cooling units and desulfurization units, and put forward a Comprehensive Energy Consumption (CEC) as target for unit sequencing and scheduling in ECD. Analysis shows that this practical target can greatly simplify the ECD model and is of great engineering significance. Simulations based on a sample are employed for demonstration.

articleTitle: Efficient improvement of new type floatation agent for coal
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper introduced a newly developed coal flotation collector ZFC and its flotation characteristics for Shanxi three different coals. ZFC was an emulsion composed by 27% diesel oil, 70% water and 3% surfactants. The surfactant PGS which was environmental friendly and reproducible, was synthesized with oil. The flotation results showed that the ZFC had the characteristics of excellent performance, high selectivity and good stability. Compared with the flotation with diesel at the similar clean coal ash, the ZFC can increase clean coal recovery and combustible material recovery by 3∼5% and 2∼5%, respectively. ZFC can greatly improve the efficiency of floatation and save about 70% diesel oil.

articleTitle: Reason analysis on the abnormal oil dissolved gas for high voltage CT
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper analyzed the abnormal oil dissolved gas on high voltage CT in power system. Through analysis, it indicated that: both electrical fault and non-electrical fault can cause abnormalities of oil dissolved gas and the corresponding solution was provided respectively. It was the first time to analyze the X wax in insulation layer of the high voltage CT and concluded that: the X wax which existed in oil-filled CT resulted from the partial discharge between the insulating layers. The amount of gases produced such as CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, etc from theoretical analysis and the measured results was consistent. This conclusion provided a theoretical basis to correctly handle the fault of a local CT.

articleTitle: Aggregate static load modeling in power grid with environmental characteristics
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In practice, there are many defects that underground load model is built by using the traditional static load model in coal mine. To enhance the accuracy of load model, a new clustering method based on improved PSO algorithm is presented in this paper. This new clustering method is used to classify the load data in order to reduce the number of load model before modeling. Then, RBF neural network based on improved PSO algorithm is proposed to establish aggregate load model. Verified by an example, compared with traditional static load model, the method in this paper can greatly improve the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: A novel diagnosis algorithm of maximum frequency for longitudinal insulation fault of transformer winding
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The transformer, as one of the most important equipment in the transmission and transformation systems, is directly related to the safety operations of the power grid. Because of the longitudinal insulation fault of transformer windings occupied the highest proportion in insulation faults, the research for the longitudinal insulation fault is has important significance for power grid. A maximum frequency algorithm is proposed in this paper to diagnose the longitudinal insulation fault in transformer winding. When frequency of maximum are obtained by compare the correlation coefficient of the voltage and current for every winding, the severity of the insulation damage can be determined from maximum frequency. The proposed method has strong fault tolerance and anti-disturbance. It is easy to use, without involving large or complicated equipments and specialized testers. Based on a large number of good results in the simulations of insulation defects with various types, the method is proved effective, practical and feasible.

articleTitle: A new harmonic and inter-harmonic parameter estimation method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In order to reduce the influence of noise signals in harmonic and inter-harmonic analysis, a new method is proposed in this paper based on modern cross-spectrum, TLS-ESPRIT and improved prony techniques. The characteristics of noise signals of zero average value in the sampling period and being independent in different time are adopted to obtain the frequency, amplitude and initial phase of sub-signals. The proposed method has been applied conditioned upon low signal noise ratio, and the simulation results have shown that this new method can distinguish more sub-signals and are characterized by the high resolution capability and good stability.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of single-phase rectification filter circuit based on matlab
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This article has established the MATLAB/Simulink models of single-phase completely controlled rectifier and three-phase completely controlled rectifier circuit. The switching process of single-phase completely controlled rectifier and three-phase completely controlled rectifier are simulated. The waveform and the sampling value of the current for the current rectifier are obtained. The harmonic component, harmonic ratio and the total harmonic distortion (THD) are obtained and have been analyzed by the FFT tool. The simulation result provides reference for the deeper understanding of the conception, means and dynamic procedure of working principle and harmonic component of the rectifier.

articleTitle: Integrated system of fuel cell for polymer electrolyte membrane
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The polymer electrolyte membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is an ionic conducting electrolyte polymer membrane. The factors which influence the performance of PEMFC include relative humidity, reaction temperature, gas inlet temperature, gas inlet pressure, and hydrogen and air flow rate. The safety control methodology strongly depends on the fuel cell operation voltage and current. In order to run the fuel cell system under the optimal operation condition, high performance stack should be arranged with the suitable subsystem and appropriate operation procedure. The research topic is to develop the control system on distributed power generation and backup power application, such as oxidant supply system, fuel supply system, heat management system, water management system, and power conditioning system. It comprises a novel PLC (Programmable Logic Control) system and human-machine interface. The controller is developed to control fuel cell system and record the operation data by using data acquisition system. The controller can be applied to high performance stack and system to obtain the best performance

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation and optimization of load change operation of high-temperature gas-cooled reactor pebble-bed module
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: High-temperature gas-cooled reactor pebble-bed module (HTR-PM) is a new type of advanced nuclear power plant developed in China. In this paper, a dynamic process model is developed in hierarchical modules, with a thermodynamic model based on IAPWS-IF97 embedded for the calculation of the physical and transport properties. Based on the developed differential-algebraic equation (DAE) model, a dynamic optimization is conducted to minimize the transient operation time at load changes. Both the synchronous and the asynchronous module operation modes are tested. A comparison with previous rule-based operation results shows that dynamic optimization can achieve better performance in transient operation.

articleTitle: Straw direct-combustion generation in Henan Province: Prospects, challenge and countermeasure
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Straw direct-combustion generation technology conforms to social development and environmental protection requirement, and is vigorously developing in Henan Province. In this article, the prospect of straw direct-combustion generation in Henan Province is elaborated, the challenge facing in this stage is pointed out. At the same time, meaningful countermeasures are provided.

articleTitle: Syndrome confounding validation of modified W-A anti-aliasing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: To study the diagnostic problem of W-A interconnect fault of PCB (Printed Circuit Board), the modified W-A anti-aliasing algorithm for interconnect test is put forward. The anti-aliasing and anti-confounding instances are proved and its fault diagnostic capability is given in the paper. Through the proving process we can find that W-A/S-D-k syndrome confounding can not exist in the diagnostic algorithm without W-A syndrome aliasing.

articleTitle: Study on transmission network expansion planning considering uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Transmission network expansion planning problem face many uncertainties in electricity market, in the paper, two uncertain factors of capacity of new-added generation company and load are considered, expected value objective and expected value constraints are adopted in the transmission planning model, a novel expected value bi-level programming model of transmission expansion planning is presented. The upper level objective is the minimization of transmission network investment cost and operation cost expected value, the upper level constraints are the number of new-added lines restraints. The lower level objective is electric power operation cost expected value, the lower level constraints include system normal operation restraints and N-1 operation restraints and system load shedding expected value restraints. Two uncertain factors are considered in the model, which satisfy different probability distribution function. Monte Carlo method is adopted to analyze the uncertain factors and expected value function. Hybrid algorithm integrated improved niche genetic algorithm with prime-dual interior point method is proposed to solve the proposed model. The results of 18-bus system were proved that the proposed model and algorithm were valid.

articleTitle: Research on on-line monitoring system for the cross connecting XLPE cable
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The cross connecting mode is widely used by the long XLPE cable. However, it is difficult to monitor the cable insulation because of the complex way of connection. This paper puts forward an on-line monitoring system for the cross connecting cable based on virtual instrument. The system adopts synchronous sampling and vector calculation as the maily analytical method. This system has the advantages of excellent anti-interference ability, good stability, powerful analysis, friendly interface, and convenient operation. It offers a good platform for the centralized monitoring and centralized management for the cables on urban power network.

articleTitle: The study on the short-term scheduling model and solutions of step power plants
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper analyses the problem of short-term scheduling of the step power plants. In the paper, optimized short-term scheduling models which take the water balance, the energy balance, the delay of water (hydraulic network), the physical properties of hydroelectric station and the capacity of reservoir into consideration is proposed. Also, the application scope and the extension method for the proposed models are presented.

articleTitle: Study on the UHF technique applied in PD detection
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Partial discharge can cause a high risk for the dielectric stability of high voltage equipment. In order to detect PD activity while equipment is operating, the ultra high frequency (UHF) detection technique is introduced. On-site PD measurements are made at cable connectors by means of log periodic dipole antenna housed outside the equipment. Thus a sensitive PD measurement even in noisy environment is possible. On-site measurements during operation showed the great potential for condition assessment [1]. This paper tries to explore the spectral distribution characteristic of electrical discharge in electric transmission and transformation equipment by using UHF technique. These researches include simulate PD sources and then use the contact-less way to discover the characteristic frequency of each type within and without the faraday cage, thereby establish the correspondence between certain characteristic frequency components of electromagnetic radiation and specific equipment deficiency. All these results showed that either radiation signal in time domain waveform or amplitude frequency diagram transformed by FFT has certain distinction and provided a basis for fault pattern recognition applied on PD detection of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Research progress of WPCB beneficiation technology
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Waste printed circuit boards(WPCB) is non-homogeneous and complex in terms of the materials and components. Despite many of the materials are highly toxic, it also contains a significant quantity of valuable resource. For instance, the contents of non-precious, precious and rare metals of WPCB are far more than their corresponding ores. Thus, it is of great significance to develop a cost-effective and environmentally friendly recycling route to dispose of WPCB. In this paper, several important beneficiation technologies of WPCB were reviewed, the negative problems during the recycling process were pointed out, and a comprehensive analysis of these methods was given. Finally, the prospects of the processing methods were addressed.

articleTitle: Research on direct torque control for a novel Radial-Flux Anti-Rotary PMSM
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In order to improve motor torque density and efficiency, the configuration and operation principle of Radial-Flux Anti-Rotary PMSM (RFAR PMSM) are introduced. After the mathematic model being deduced, simulation model of RFAR PMSM is established using Matlab/Simulink software. A new direct torque control system for RFAR PMSM is designed, and the speed following strategy of two rotors on disturbance condition is proposed to maintain the equal speed of two rotors. The simulation result, which well matches the theory analysis verified that direct torque control is competent for speed regulating of RFAR PMSM with advantages of high mechanical robustness and quick torque response.

articleTitle: Design on four-quadrant DC/AC converter for wind power flow optimization system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A four-quadrant DC/AC converter for wind power flow optimization system is designed. Firstly, the basic idea of wind power flow optimization and control is analyzed. Secondly, working principle of the four-quadrant DC/AC converter is explained and its linear small signal mathematical model in the rotating reference frame is constructed. Then, based on the model, control unit consisting of active current PI close-loop regulation and reactive current one is designed. The high frequency component of the output power of wind power generation is separated by a one-order low pass filter, which is used to produce the active power command of the converter. In addition, the reactive power command is produced based on the deviation between the gird voltage in real time and the ideal one. The experimental results show that the converter can rapidly and accurately trace active power command and reactive power one of different direction and size.

articleTitle: The experimental research on performance of air accumulator in compressed air technological system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In light of the function of air accumulator on balancing peak load and stabilizing air supply parameters, it has been widely used in compressed air system. In this paper, operating characteristic and performance of air accumulator in the inflating condition of constant inlet pressure or flow rate was obtained via experimental research. In addition, the improving methods were proposed, which may afford reference on the design of air accumulator.

articleTitle: Research of time synchronization in ECT/EVT of intelligent substation IEEE1588-based
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The application of electronic transformer brings sampling time synchronization problem, this paper introduces the IEEE1588 which is Precision Time Protocol (PTP) into the synchronization time electric power system. This paper gives the principle of IEEE1588, analyzes the influence factors of the clock synchronization and two solutions. Based on the synchronization of electronic transformers currently, a new high precision synchronization based on the IEEE1588 Protocol is proposed. At last, the value and effectiveness of the synchronization is summarized.

articleTitle: Simulation research on impulse characteristics of horizontal grounding conductor
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Impulse grounding resistance is closely related to lightning withstand level of transmission line towers, so study on the impulse characteristics of tower grounding conductors is of great significance. This paper, based on circuit theory, uses electromagnetic transient analysis software ATPDraw to simulate impulse characteristics. Control function of ATPDraw can simulate inductance effect and spark discharge effect well when lightning current flows through the grounding conductor, improving the existing simulation model. In this paper, a single extended model is established and the characteristics that inductance effect varies with the length and spark discharge with the current amplitude are researched. Simulation results are compared with laboratory test conclusion and they are identical which testify that the model and method is reliable.

articleTitle: Application and research on a variety of SMES outer ring control strategies for inhibiting UHV tie-line's power oscillation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The UHV experimental demonstration project of Chang Zhi-Nan Yang-Jing Men is currently the only tie-line in two large areas' power grid between North and Central China. Since it was put into operation in 2008, the tie-line produced substantial power fluctuations. The Superconductor Magnetics Energy System (SMES) device had the nondestructive efficient energy storage and quick electrical energy conversion properties. The mechanism of SMES device inhibiting power oscillation was analyzed, the electro-magnetic transient model was established in the two areas and four machines system containing SMES. A variety of SMES outer-ring control strategies were employed to execute simulation and calculation in order to inhibit tie-line's power oscillation, and it compared the advantages and disadvantages of several control strategies. Simulation results indicated that: The SMES device based on a variety of outer-ring control strategies can efficiently inhibit UHV tie-line's power oscillation and enhance the stability level of the two areas' power grid between North and Central China.

articleTitle: Information management system of FRID tag auto-fill and tape performance
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: FRID system is applied to information management system of tape performance, and then information management system of FRID tag auto-fill and tape performance is developed in this paper. Through the use of a powerful data interface which is provided by PLC control unit, tag fill and detection can be achieved automatically and real-time performance information on the tape management is realized which decreases the human effort and increases the efficiency of tape management at the same time.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Control technique on output power quality for doubly fed wind power system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Appling improvement of the inverse time overload protection of large generating units
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Inverse time protection is widely used in overload protection scheme of large generating units, but the operation curve adopted by inverse-time overload protection is different from the practical overload curve of generating units. Hence, there are many inconveniences for application of inverse-time overload protection. Problems about constitution of inverse-time characteristic curve, realization of micro-computer and curve-fitting are analyzed in this paper. Setting principles for inverse-time overload protection of large generating units are described, based on its application in protection scheme of large-scaled generating units installed in Three Gorges Right Bank Power Station.

articleTitle: Optimization and simulation of primary frequency regulation of DEH for turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper discusses the optimization of primary frequency regulation of DEH for turbine with Simulink Software based on MATLAB. Two models, the original system before optimized and optimized system, are built and simulated with Simulink Software. The comparison with simulation results of two models shows that the performance of DEH raises a lot after optimized, providing theory bases for improving DEH.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Automatic generation control based on PSO and on-line generator parameter identification
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: An adaptive method of model reduction in frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper presents an adaptive model reduction method. This method is based on the continuous-time rational orthogonal basis (Takenaka-Malmquist basis). By selecting optimal points for the rational orthogonal basis, it is to find a fast approximation in the energy sense. The steady-state values of step responses are kept to be equal, and the stability of the order-reduced models is remained.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design of resonance elimination in 10kV power system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Linear quadratic optimal algorithm on cooling route control
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The optimal control based on linear quadratic algorithm was applied on the temperature control of steel plate on the runout table especially with ultra fast cooling combining with laminar cooling. Based on the unit water flow, target temperature and different cooling route, the optimal algorithm is built. The precise temperature control and water flow control are achieved.

articleTitle: Harmonic current model for medium-frequency furnace based on general regression neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A general regression neural network (GRNN) is proposed for harmonic current modeling of medium-frequency furnace (MFF) in steady-state frequency-domain. In the model, a new concept of fundamental active power load degree (FAPLD) is introduced, which is the ratio of load fundamental active power to its rated power; the nonlinear mapping between FAPLD and each order of harmonic current amplitude is established by GRNN. The interrelationships between FAPLD and current amplitude of each harmonic are discussed. GRNN has the advantages of good nonlinear mapping, small samples for modeling, few man-determined parameters, etc. Numerical results show that the proposed model has the characteristics of short training time, high precision and dynamic modeling; it is an effective method for building up harmonic current model of MFF.

articleTitle: Ship harmonics of sub-synchronous vibration
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Modern ships have been widely equipped with electric propulsion system. With the ships becoming larger, the load also being larger and more modern equipments, the micro-grid system is also more complex. Therefore, the stability of the micro-grid requirements is increasing. This article firstly describes that the structure of marine power system is a multi-motor structure which is the hybrid system of the AC load and DC load, so the ship micro-grid harmonic problem is serious. The harmonics and other instability reasons can cause sub-synchronous oscillation in the micro-grid system. Then the article describes the mechanism of sub-synchronous oscillations, and, starting from the principle, innovatively establishes a gas turbine five-axis model under the PSCAD simulation. Through the simulation, it can be found that generators are prone to torsional vibration. To avoid this situation, the article analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the common methods. Serial capacitors are used to eliminate some harmonics and to compensate the line. By taking this reliable way to eliminate and reduce sub-synchronous oscillation, it is finally verified on simulation and demonstrated feasible.

articleTitle: Detecting methods of reactive power and harmonic current in electrified railway systems
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In order to detect the reactive power current and harmonic current in electrified railway systems, three detecting methods are proposed in this paper. There are methods based on instantaneous reactive power theory, function orthogonal characteristic and active current separate method. The corresponding detection systems are developed, and simulations are performed which verify the feasibility of the methods proposed. With higher precision and the real-time performance, the second and the third methods are recommended in electrified railway systems.

articleTitle: Sound guidance vehicle based on AT89S52
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This system centers on high-performance microcontroller AT89S52. Through the motor control on ASSP chip MMC-1 which controlling two DC motors, it can achieve accuracy position control of the moving acoustic. The buzzer can make an aural signal on a certain frequency using the microcontroller AT89S52. Because the distances between the three audio receivers and the moving acoustic are different, the signal they receive has a certain time difference. Then the control system makes a control signal according to the time difference. This signal is transmitted to the moving sound source through a wireless transceiver module and guides its motion.

articleTitle: The structure analysis and design of a new self-optimizing fuzzy controller based on Nelder-Mead simplex method
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: With analyzing the shortcomings in the conventional fuzzy controllers that the steady state errors and its changing rate cannot be eliminated, as well as the good dynamic characteristics and steady-state properties cannot be simultaneously obtained, a new kind of self-optimizing fuzzy controller, which utilizes Nelder-Mead simplex method to automatically optimize the quantifying factor, scaling factor and integral tuning factor is designed and implemented in MATLAB environment. The simulation results indicate that the controller has strong anti-jamming capacity and fairly good accuracy in its static and dynamic control performances.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A new method of acquisition original reliability parameters for power grid planning
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A deliverability analysis of herringbone well under open hole series completion system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Open hole series completion system were considered as a main research object in a new deliverability forecasting model in order to offer reference to completion decision making for horizontal multilateral well. This model, which took herringbone well for example, coupled reservoir inflow with wellbore flow and was solute with a semi-analytical discretization theory. As a result of iterative operation, distribution profile of flow rate and flowing pressure as well as IPR curve of whole well were obtained. What's more, productions under different completion methods were compared. Through analysis and study, it's known that, firstly, seepage interference within multilateral well restrain total production, whose degree depends on herringbone well configuration, filtration resistance and mining intensity. Secondly, completion system influence both flow rate distribution and flowing pressure distribution because completion screen pipe in the wellbore affects drawdown of reservoir inflow and wellbore flow. Finally, well completion screen pipe and its running model should be selected based on technical and economic aspects.

articleTitle: Comparison of methods for the perturbed trajectory prediction based on wide area measurements
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: With the wide use of phasor measurement unit (PMU) and Wide Area Measurement System (WAMS), the transient instability real time prediction has been one of hot issues in power systems. The perturbed rotor angle trajectory prediction is a key step for transient instability prediction. The curve fitting based perturbed trajectory extrapolation methods had been paid widely attention since they do not need the knowledge of the network topology, model and parameters of power system and do not need network equivalence. Only a few post-fault measurements are required. The existed methods, such as the polynomial model, the trigonometric function model, the auto-regressive model and the angular velocity prediction & integration based method, are overviewed in this paper respectively. The experimental simulations on both IEEE 39-bus system and China Southern Power Grid are done to test the effectiveness of these models. An analysis and comparison is presented in terms of the fault condition, the sampling period, the number of the required measurements and the forecasting accuracy. The numerical results show that the polynomial model based prediction method has best effects for perturbed rotor angle trajectory prediction in terms of stability, rapidity and accuracy.

Author Keywords: Angular velocity prediction and integration based method

articleTitle: Embedded real-time system modeling language analysis and comparison
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Auto cruise control system (CCS) is a typical case of embedded real-time systems (RTES). Model-based design method describes both system software and hardware structure by the effective modeling language in RTES. That satisfies RTES real-time capability and reliability, and enhances productivity and saves cost expenses. This paper models CCS using the modeling languages UML (Unified Modeling Language) and AADL (Architecture Analysis and Design Language) respectively, and analyzes the characteristics of the two languages, then discusses RTES modeling development trend.

articleTitle: Study of the effects of low and high stoichiometry on the flame stabilization during oxycoal combustion with Non-Stoichiometric Burners
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper presents the combustion of pulverised coal in a mixture of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> under oxyfuel firing conditions. The performance of two different oxycoal burner designs, a 35mm core diameter and a 50mm core diameter based burner was tested with different angles of deflectors, length of quarl under low and high stoichiometry. Based on numerical simulations, the main parameters influencing the stability of pulverised coal swirl flame were investigated.

articleTitle: The effects analysis of measurement anomaly in electricity settlement of provincial generation power market
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The malfunction of measuring apparatus is almost inevitable in electric system and will result in inaccurate settlement amount of electricity sales. The backup measures, such as dual-apparatus, calculations from the measurement on other side of line or Tele Meter Reading of EMS are helpful to rectify the erroneous data. Data interpolation is the final solution as those alternatives absent. The impact of estimation of measuring data on settlement is different while the period of electricity prices and settlement are alternating respectively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of low-electrode displacement effect on standard high-voltage compressed gas capacitor
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Development of the driver of data acquisition card for embedded operating system WinCE6.0
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: With the development of IC technology, the wafer diameter is developing to 300mm. This will significantly increase the requirement of the accuracy and the real-time performance of data acquisition. This paper introduces the theory of stream interface driver of WinCE and structure of the Acquisition Card ADT882. Then the implement the driver of ADT882 for WinCE6.0 is described. The testing results show that this meets the design requirement in functionality, performance and stability.

articleTitle: Research on overload protection inverse time characteristic for pumped storage generator-motors
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Overload protection plays an important role in safeguarding the operation security and efficiency of large-capacity pumped storage units. Different types of inverse time characteristics of overload protection are utilized in practical protection devices. In order to improve the performance of overload protection in practical applications, a real pumped storage unit model is adopted to analyze the relationship among different inverse time characteristics of overload protection.

articleTitle: The characteristics of generator and load in the calculation of network loss modification
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: It is a practical method currently to do network loss modification by incremental transmission losses because its clear physical concept and simple calculation process and consistent accuracy. Now, the method for computing incremental transmission losses is mostly based on the computing of power flow. In the practical calculation, the unbalance power is absorbed by the ‘buffer machine’. This paper use dispersed generators and dispersed load to absorb the unbalance power, and based on these experiments to research the influence of characteristics of generator and load in the computation of the incremental transmission losses-σ.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Resonance over-voltage analysis of long distance varied frequency driving system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A measurement-based model validation tool of large scale power systems
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Model validation is a basic and important work to ensure the dynamic simulation accuracy which influences the decision of power system design, planning, operation and control. Because large scale power systems have a great many components, the model validation work is very complex. A measurement-based model validation software(PSMV) is introduced in the paper. Current simulation accuracy can be evaluated by trajectory comparison between measurements and simulations all around the grid. Effects of models and parameters to the dynamic trajectories during a disturbance can be investigated by modification of model types and parameter values. Dominant parameters that can be reliable estimated for a certain trajectory are selected by trajectory sensitivity ranking. Parameter estimation of large scale power systems can also be performed efficiently using the software. The software has been used in Northeast China Power Grid Company.

articleTitle: Research on impacts and prospects of widespread use of electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This article mainly focuses on the impacts and prospects of the widespread use of electric vehicles. Firstly, Cellular Automata is used to calculate the maximum pollution tolerance of the land to evaluate environmental impact, and then HD Model with the combination of One-compartment model based on pollutant density absorption have been built to analyze the health impact. Finally, V2G technology and its influence to the power grid are analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Fuzzy logic-based AQM controller design research
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Internet congestion control can be respected as a nonlinear feedback system with uncertainties and communication delay. According to this characteristic, a self-configuring Active Queue Management (AQM) controller is proposed utilizing the predominance of fuzzy theory in dealing with the uncertain event and its stability is analyzed using Lyapunov Direct method, and the performance is analyzed using NS-2 simulation system. Compared with other traditional method, the algorithm is more reasonable, stable and robust. This electronic document is a “live” template. articleTitle: Parallel distributed compensator design for process control based on fuzzy Takagi-Sugeno model
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy controller is designed based on Parallel Distributed Compensation (PDC) method and it is implemented in an experimental tank level control system. Firstly, a mathematical model of the system is obtained experimentally. To control the level of water in the tank over the whole range, the nonlinear model of the system is linearized around three different operating points. Then, three PI controllers are designed for the operating points. By using the PDC method, an overall fuzzy controller is designed by the fuzzy blending of the three PI-controllers. To evaluate the practical performance of the PDC-based fuzzy controller, the control system is implemented in the experimental system. The comparison results showed the superiority of the PDC-controller over the classical PI-controller.

articleTitle: Research and development of virtual software for safety control system TXS in nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: After deeply studying TXP/TXS in a 1000MW nuclear power plant, in this paper, we particularly take safety control system TXS as the simulation object, then researches and develops its virtual software VTXS(Virtual TXS) on Windows platform. VTXS is based on automatic code analysis and translation and developed in Visual C++. In this research and development, we have used technologies such as multithreading, multi-process communication, and the principles of object-oriented modeling and modularization program design. VTXS can realize the functions of real TXS with high fidelity in the form of software.

articleTitle: Overview of hydrogen production by biomass gasification
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Hydrogen production by biomass gasification is a new way for hydrogen production. In the paper, we review the research and the utilization in China and Europe. And it also discusses the research of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> elimination by LUAT.

articleTitle: Design of the Two-way Smart Meter based on industrial ethernet
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The Two-way Smart Meter is a terminal equipment of Smart Distribution Grid. Along with maturity of Smart Distribution Grid(SDG) and application of New Energy, it is very obvious that the application of the Two-way Smart Meter is valuable. The Smart Meter which designed in this paper is practical and can be produced.

articleTitle: Bifurcation of multiple limit cycles for the systems of thermonuclear reaction in Tokamaks
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper mainly studies the physical model of thermonuclear reaction in Tokamaks, analysis the L-mode to H-mode transition near the plasma edge in Tokamaks by using the theory of nonlinear dynamics. Obtaining the averaged equations by using the method of multiple scales, we not only make some dynamics analysis for unperturbed and perturbed system, but also give out parameter bifurcation diagrams and diagram composition about bifurcation of multiple limit cycles for Tokamaks system.

articleTitle: Design of foxboro I/A virtual simulation software in nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In order to reduce accidents in nuclear power plant, simulation for operator training and system validation precommission is very important. The application of Foxboro I/A control system in nuclear power plant leads to the development of its virtual simulation software. In this paper, a reasonable structure of its virtual software is established. Real-time server software VCP and human-machine interface VWP form the two parts of the virtual simulation software. The VCP is built by VC6.0++; the VWP page is embedded by ActiveX dynamic OCX and browsed by IE. The Virtual simulation software for Foxboro I/A control system is crucial to security and economy of nuclear power plant in present and in the future.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on the heat transfer characteristics of a double pipe heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A finite volume method model on the double-pipe heat exchanger with constant thermal flux in inner tube was established. The film convective heat transfer coefficient was obtained under the conditions of laminar flow, transitional flow and turbulent flow. The two-dimensional axial symmetry model was adopted, and the implicit format was used in discrete equations. In comparison with classic empirical formula of film convective heat transfer coefficient, the error of results in this paper was within 15%, and the model could serve the engineering practice as a reference.

articleTitle: Overvoltages of 40.5 kV vacuum circuit breaker switching off shunt reactors
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: To investigate the reason of the severe overvoltage failures of 40.5 kV vacuum circuit breakers during switching off shunt reactors, a series of field tests were carried out. The transient process is analyzed, and the magnitude and the characteristics of the transient recovery voltages (TRV) are analyzed. The experiment results indicate that multi-reignition in 35 kV system is much more serious than that in 10 kV system, and the inter-phase overvoltage is especially critical. Additionally, the relationship between the breakdown voltage and the operating moment is exponentially fitted. The result could be used to simulate the overvoltage process when vacuum circuit breakers switch off shunt reactors.

articleTitle: Vulnerability analysis of power grid considering the different stages with faults evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The evolutions after the disturbance, namely transient stability, power flow response and generation re-dispatch, ware defined as vulnerability analysis stages. A set of indices for describing intensity and impact scope of power grid vulnerability was established from the viewpoint of transient potential energy accumulation and transmission line's margin respectively. The proposed algorithm gives prominence to the principal issues of different stages and can be used to identify the critical lines and vulnerability level of important transmission sections. New England benchmark system was simulated to verify the effectiveness of methods. The proposed functions have been well integrated in the Power Dispatch Visualization Platform (PDVP) developed by Sichuan University.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on high accurate position control of synchronous vacuum circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference

articleTitle: Research on morphological characteristics of sewage sludge pyrolysis process
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Sewage sludge corresponds to some special morphological characteristics during its pyrolysis process. In this paper, photographic images of sewage sludge during its pyrolysis under 400°C were sampled for the whole process to identify its different stages. Digital image processing technology has been applied to obtain the quantitative morphological characteristics of these photographs; the relevance of these characteristics and the pyrolysis process is also discussed. It has been found that both the main area of sewage sludge layer and the optical densities of channels R(red), G(green) and B(Blue) reduce with the pyrolysis process, and the optical densities are closely related to the pyrolysis stages. Also by analyzing experimental data the changing curve of averaged optical density of RGB with reaction time is found to satisfy DoseResp function, which provides an innovative method for automatic control of sewage sludge pyrolysis process.

articleTitle: A study of doubly-fed speed regulation system based on stator flux orientation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In this paper, a doubly-fed speed regulation system employing a core TMS320LF 2407A-type DSP(Digital Signal Processor) chip controller and using the stator flux oriented vector control strategy has been described and analyzed. Its main circuit configuration figure and control block diagram are given as well. The speed of the motor, the stator voltage and current of the simulation waveforms can be obtained under different operating conditions by using our established simulation model of the system, which is built in a MATLAB / Simulink environment. The obtained simulation results have demonstrated feasibility and superiority of the proposed doubly-fed speed regulation method.

articleTitle: Research on wind turbine simulator based on B&R servo controller
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: As to conduct the wind power generation experimental research in laboratory, a feasible scheme which simulates the characteristics of wind turbine using the synchronous motor controlled by servo controller was proposed. The operational principle of the wind turbine was analyzed and the mathematical model of the wind turbine was built. The wind turbine simulation system has been designed on the basis of studying the vector control principle of servo control system. The system consists of B&R Programmed Computer Controller (PCC), servo controller, synchronous motor and hysterics absorption dynamometer. The B&R servo controller has been adapted to control the synchronous motor to simulate the performance characteristic of the wind turbine. The simulation results in MALAB/SIMULINK and the experimental results in platform has confirmed the validation of the plan..

articleTitle: Excitation control system based on multi-objective Heuristic Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A multi-objective adaptive dynamic programming method is proposed in this paper to solve the optimal control with multi-objective performance indices. The multi-objective performance indices are commonly used in engineering fields. In the paper, vector-valued performance indices are transformed into a scalar by vector's 2-norm. Multi-objective adaptive dynamic programming is derived from adaptive critic design and neural network. Heuristic Dynamic Programming (HDP) is a member of Adaptive Dynamic Programming. This method is implemented with Neural Network, so it does not require an accurate model of the plant. The dynamics of the system is learned from the history data, and from the data of real time control process. The proposed method updates the controller's parameters periodically, so the control law can be updated with the change of environment. It solves the problem step by step and optimizes the multi-objective performance indices in real time. The simulation shows the effectiveness of the method in the excitation control of synchronous generators.

articleTitle: An image processing techniques for image enhancement of electrical resistance tomography
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In this paper, we present a combined method based on image processing techniques for image enhancement in electrical resistance tomography (ERT). Image reconstruction in ERT is an ill-posed inverse problem and the most significant drawback of ERT is its poor image quality. We have designed and simulated a new image reconstruction method using image processing techniques to enhance ERT images. The first stage of ERT forward and reverse solver is reach to raw images and then, in second stage, an image noise elimination technique is applied to extract better results from the first step images. Simulation results are presented and compared to those obtained by other more established method such as modified Newton-Raphson (mNR). Results show that the proposed method can sufficiently enhance quality of ERT images. Comparison in results between numerically solved method and the hybrid method represents a considerable improvement in final image quality.

articleTitle: Study and application of multiple model adaptive control strategy in power system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Installing damping controller is an effective means to prevent the emergence of low-frequency oscillation in the interconnected power system. The control strategy of traditional Linear TCSC(thyristor controlled series compensator) damping controller is simple and easy to be implemented, but its adaptability and robustness is poor; the nonlinear TCSC damping controller has the better adaptability and robustness, but its control strategy is too complicated. To solve these problems, A multiple model adaptive control strategy is put forward in this thesis. Based on the recursive Bayes theorem, the weight for each model is calculated and final output of the controller is synthesized by the weights. A more satisfied performance in adaptive and robust for the new model is proofed by the simulation result.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Application study on eccentric K-joint with high-neck forging flange applied in steel tube transmission tower
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference

articleTitle: Hopf bifurcation analysis and control of the Newton-Leipnik system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Newton-Leipnik system is the system that has double strange attractor, and for different parameters its seven equilibrium points are all unstable. In this paper, first of all, we study the characteristics of these seven unstable equilibrium points in order to find out the Hopf bifurcation points, then design a new nonlinear controller based on the bifurcation theory of nonlinear system, and through adding the new nonlinear controller in the original system, moves the Hopf bifurcation point to a new designated position successfully.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Real-time precision detection voltage flicker
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference

articleTitle: Comprehensive benefits based multi-objective evaluation with incomplete information for hydropower plant construction
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The comprehensive utilization hydropower project not only plays a role in power generation and flood control, but also has some benefits in navigation, water supply, irrigation, aquaculture, and tourism. Meanwhile, it greatly influences the basin ecological environment. Firstly, quantitative calculation methods for several types of benefits from hydropower development were proposed. Secondly, the benefit relationship between the hydropower development company and the area influenced by the hydropower station was discussed. Then, a multi-objective evaluation model with incomplete information was built based on comprehensive benefits. Finally, an example was given to demonstrate the rationality on the construction of R station which was built in some river of southwestern China. It is shown that the proposed approach is an effective method for the feasibility study and benefits evaluation of the hydropower station.

articleTitle: A system for continuously measuring PV maximum power point at high speed and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper has reported a system developed for continuously measuring PV maximum power point (MPP) at high speed. The preliminary results obtained with the system show that MPP power is directly proportional to the insolation, while MPP voltage does not change much with the insolation. With the preliminary results, we inferred that the optimum MPPT time intervals for fine, cloudy and rainy days are about 35s, 7s and 15 s, respectively.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Discussion on the integration of Distributed Control System in large thermal power plant
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference

articleTitle: Research on mechanical fault diagnoses methodology of a circuit breaker based on the voltage and current during its operation
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The performance of a circuit breaker during its operation has great impact to the power system security and is of great concern to the operation and management department of power grid. This paper presents a new method to acquire the performance information of the circuit breaker during its connecting/disconnecting operation through the voltage and current waveforms‥ Due to capacitance effects between dynamic and static contact, the voltage and current parameters in the process of connecting/disconnecting can be decomposed into two parts by orthogonal transformation method. The two parts are active and reactive power. The reactive component is generated by the capacitance effects. When the circuit breaker mechanical failure, particularly in velocity of contact anomalies, the capacitance effects will naturally be affected, that is, the reactive component will contain abnormal part inevitably. This method can effectively suppress interference, highlight the major characteristic quantities of the circuit breaker, and evaluate its mechanical performance.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of synchronous generator-rectifier system with constant power loads
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Stability of synchronous generator-rectifier system directly feeding constant power loads (CPLs) is studied in this paper. Stability condition is derived by small-signal analysis. The system stability is well improved through the method of passive damping. Simulations and experiments are used to validate the theory analysis.

publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference

articleTitle: Robust stabilization of optimal T-S fuzzy control systems
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: This paper deals with the stability analysis and control law design of a class of fuzzy systems. By taking advantage of the structure information of the premise rule base, piecewise fuzzy Lyapunov function is proposed. Based on the piecewise fuzzy Lyapunov function, a control design method for stabilization of fuzzy system is derived in the format of linear inequality matrix (LMI). This method reduces the conservatism of both piecewise Lyapunov function and fuzzy Lyapunov function. The stability condition obtained is more relaxed and the control system has good performance. The efficiency of the method is illustrated through the simulation of some numerical examples.

articleTitle: Investigation of voltage-current characteristics of ZnO varistors under 8/20µs impulse current
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: Voltage-current profiles of ZnO varistors are important electrical characteristics to denote its surge suppression capabilities. A kind of commercial low-voltage ZnO varistors was studied under impulse current. As an 8/20μs inductive lightning current pass through it, it can be observed that in a whole voltage-current curve the current rising track does not overlap the current falling track accurately, and the former is always higher than the later. This phenomenon can be inferred to relate with the transition conduction process of ZnO varistor, and it can be explained qualitatively by hole-induced tunnel breakdown theory.

articleTitle: The research of hydro-thermal exchange based on virtual electricity trade
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: A market for virtual electricity trade is formed with the basis of hydro-thermal exchange in this paper. Based on the virtual electricity market, each participants formulate their own plan considering the principle of maximizing benefits. This paper sets up an optimal dispatch model for electricity volume exchanged among plants which participate in the virtual electricity trades. The calculation indicates that the discussed model can leverage the current two factors, state energy policies and market mechanism quite well and can be practically used in the initial phase of electricity market reform of our country.

articleTitle: Intelligent retrieval in power quality evaluation application
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: In the power system, the query on power grid operating parameters are generally based on directory-inquiry approach. For large-scale grid, the efficiency of this retrieval method is fairly low, and also lack of data evaluation. In view of the defect, this article presents a semantic structure of intelligent retrieval system for power system, which bases on ontology. It divided the query words into two parts through the method of word segmentation, which consists of location and evaluation section. By analyzing the location section to locate the object carrier position, and analyze the evaluation section to evaluate the data by the rules in power system, finally present the outcome to user sort by special style. It not only runs fast on querying data, but also has the ability to analyze the collected data.

articleTitle: Design of the smart charger for miner's cap lamp with safety monitor system
publicationTitle: 2011 IEEE Power Engineering and Automation Conference
abstract: The smart charger for miner's cap lamp with safety monitor system is developed in this paper, which can recharge various kinds of Li-ion rechargeable batteries matching with it. The multiplexing technology is applied to the data exchange between the charger and the miner's cap lamp during charging process. The lamp's charge cycles, production date and operation logs can be read out and transmitted to the charging management computer via RS485 bus for the convenience of safety supervision from National Safety Production Supervision Department or miner's cap lamp manufacturer.
